name: OYM Trilogy 2026 – Leg 2
short_description: OYM Trilogy 2026 – Leg 2 is a half-marathon race set for September 27, 2026 at Ayala Triangle Gardens, Makati, Philippines.
ai_summary: OYM Trilogy 2026 – Leg 2 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 27, 2026, at Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati, Philippines. Organized by OYM, the race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 16km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from casual participants to those seeking a longer challenge. Registration for this event has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 16km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Central, accessible venue at Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati
Organized event as part of a known series, OYM Trilogy
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: Course is based at Ayala Triangle Gardens / Legazpi Village area in Makati's central business district, with categories including 5K, 10K, 16K and a 21K half-marathon for Leg 2.
Hard course cut-off is 6:30 AM to allow road reopening, and runners arriving more than 15 minutes late to their category's flag-off are disqualified for safety.
Hydration stations are placed every 2 to 2.5 km along the route, with medical teams and ambulances stationed at start, finish and along the course.
OYM Trilogy is a three-leg progressive series where completing all three legs lets you interlock medals into one larger commemorative trophy.
OYM returned in 2026 after a pandemic-era pause, positioning itself as a community-oriented series for beginner-to-intermediate runners moving up in distance.
research_watchouts: Early gun start and a strict 6:30 AM road-reopening cut-off mean slower runners on longer distances (16K/21K) have limited time margin.

No independent participant race reports or reviews of this specific 2026 edition were found online at the time of research; available material is largely from the organizer and race-calendar listing sites.
